data.body: **[P2] Do not convert JVM-fatal MDC capture failures into durable failures.** This catch also absorbs direct or wrapped `VirtualMachineError`/`ThreadDeath`; the handler future is then processed as an ordinary user failure and the workflow can be marked `FAILED`. Classify capture failures with the existing identity-safe fatal logic and route fatal cases through a caller-visible fatal signal while still settling the future; retain the current path only for nonfatal failures. Add direct and wrapped fatal capture tests.
